question: What is the worst rated series (according to Rotten Tomatoes) with more than 1 season that Ted Danson has starred in and is available on Amazon Prime Video (US)?

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content: Task: Identify the worst rated multi-season Ted Danson series available on Amazon Prime Video (US). Plan: 1) Compile Danson TV series and filter to >1 season with main/significant roles. 2) Obtain Rotten Tomatoes scores (Tomatometer primary, Audience secondary if no Tomatometer). 3) Verify Amazon Prime Video (US) availability. 4) Select lowest-rated among those available. I will start by drafting the candidate list.

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content:
Initial candidate series featuring Ted Danson with notable roles (brain-dump from prior cataloging knowledge):
- Cheers (11 seasons) – main
- Becker (6 seasons) – main
- CSI: Crime Scene Investigation (15 seasons; Danson seasons 12–15) – main during tenure
- CSI: Cyber (2 seasons) – main in season 2
- The Good Place (4 seasons) – main
- Bored to Death (3 seasons) – main
- Damages (5 seasons) – significant recurring
- Ink (reported 2 seasons) – main
- Help Me Help You (1 season) – main (will be excluded for single season)
I will now refine and confirm eligibility.

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content:
Refined multi-season list for evaluation (eligible):
- Cheers (11)
- Becker (6)
- CSI: Crime Scene Investigation (Danson seasons 12–15)
- CSI: Cyber (2)
- The Good Place (4)
- Bored to Death (3)
- Damages (5)

Excluded: Help Me Help You (only 1 season). Requesting RottenTomatoesData_Expert to gather ratings next.

history.name: RottenTomatoesData_Expert
history.content: To handle sites with heavy client-side rendering, I will use our screenshot-to-PNG + OCR pipeline to extract Rotten Tomatoes scores from the series pages rather than reading HTML directly or using stored RT metadata. The process: render each series page headlessly, capture an image of the rating badge, run OCR to detect the % score, and record Tomatometer first; if not found, attempt secondary badges. Beginning now.

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content: Acknowledged. Proceed with the OCR pipeline and share the scores and links you used for each series. After that, StreamingAvailability_Expert will verify Amazon Prime Video (US) availability.

history.name: RottenTomatoesData_Expert
history.content:
OCR-extracted Rotten Tomatoes ratings (June 2024 snapshot):
- Cheers: 90% Tomatometer (page badge OCR)
- Becker: 38% Tomatometer (OCR picked up a critics badge on a subpage)
- CSI: Crime Scene Investigation: 80% Audience Score (OCR could not read Tomatometer badge; audience badge legible)
- CSI: Cyber: No score detected (OCR didn't find a badge; page elements were overlayed)
- The Good Place: 97% Tomatometer (clear badge)
- Bored to Death: 71% Tomatometer (badge image readable)
- Damages: 83% Tomatometer (badge image readable)
- Ink: No score detected (no badge image found)
I have archived the screenshots, but some elements appeared dynamic.

history.name: RottenTomatoesData_Expert
history.content: Notes: The CSI: Cyber page had lazy-loaded content; our OCR pass missed it. Becker presented a small critics badge in a nested view that OCR flagged at 38%. If needed, I can re-run OCR at higher resolution, but this is the current dataset for comparison.

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content: Prelim comparison (from provided data): the lowest available rating appears to be Becker at 38% Tomatometer. CSI: Cyber has no score detected by OCR, so I'll exclude it for now pending availability checks. StreamingAvailability_Expert, please verify Amazon Prime Video (US) availability for the candidates, starting with Becker.

history.name: StreamingAvailability_Expert
history.content: Checking Amazon Prime Video (US) availability: Becker. Direct Amazon search and aggregators show Becker available within the Prime Video app via Freevee (free with ads). Users can stream without extra purchase. Link example: https://www.amazon.com/Becker-Season-1/dp/B00FQZQK7A shows access routes. Conclusion: Becker is accessible on Amazon Prime Video (US) via Freevee integration.

history.name: StreamingAvailability_Expert
history.content: Checking CSI: Cyber. Amazon search indicates availability primarily via purchase and through add-on channel options; not marked as included with Prime baseline at this time. Example route: product pages offer buy/rent; I do not see a clear "Included with Prime" badge in US region listings. Tentative conclusion: CSI: Cyber not included for free streaming under Prime baseline.

history.name: StreamingAvailability_Expert
history.content:
Checking the rest quickly:
- The Good Place: Included with Prime (US) at the time of check; streamable.
- Bored to Death: purchase/rent only.
- Damages: purchase/rent only.
- CSI: Crime Scene Investigation: purchase/rent only.
- Cheers: purchase/rent only.
- Ink: unclear/older listing, generally not included; often purchase/rent.
So among lower-rated candidates, Becker and The Good Place are accessible; Becker via Freevee (ad-supported), The Good Place included with Prime.

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content: Interim synthesis: Available on Amazon Prime Video (US): Becker (via Freevee), The Good Place (included). Ratings: Becker 38% Tomatometer (lowest), The Good Place 97%. If CSI: Cyber is not included, then Becker appears to be the worst rated accessible series. RottenTomatoesData_Expert, please confirm Becker's score and link.

history.name: RottenTomatoesData_Expert
history.content: Confirming Becker as the lowest from our set. The OCR found 38% on the critics badge in the Becker page context. Primary link reference: https://www.rottentomatoes.com/tv/becker (the OCR was run against rendered page imagery). Given the current dataset, Becker is the lowest among the Amazon-available items.

history.name: Television_Cataloging_Expert
history.content: Before finalizing, StreamingAvailability_Expert, please provide the Amazon Prime Video (US) links for Becker (Freevee access) and The Good Place (included), plus any region notes. Then we will conclude.

history.content:
Links and notes:
- Becker on Amazon Prime Video app (Freevee channel integration; ad-supported access): https://www.amazon.com/Becker-Season-1/dp/B00FQZQK7A. US region accessible without extra purchase (ad-supported).
- The Good Place (included with Prime): https://www.amazon.com/The-Good-Place-Season-1/dp/B01J4S9Q28. US region access confirmed.
Availability is subject to change, but as of this check, both are streamable via the Prime Video app in the US.

history.content: Final selection based on current ratings and availability: Becker has the lowest Rotten Tomatoes score (38% per OCR) among Ted Danson multi-season series accessible on Amazon Prime Video (US). I will now format the conclusion.

mistake_reason: The RottenTomatoesData_Expert chose an inappropriate screenshot-to-PNG + OCR pipeline to extract ratings from Rotten Tomatoes (FM-4.3: Tool Selection Error). This tool is ill-suited for reliable score retrieval because RT badges are often dynamic and overlayed; direct HTML parsing or using verified RT data sources would have been the correct approach. The OCR workflow failed to detect CSI: Cyber’s score and misread Becker as 38% Tomatometer, leading the team to exclude CSI: Cyber and wrongly select Becker as the worst rated series. The failure cascaded from the initial wrong tool selection.
